high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "demonandesire." The post was made on 3 February and has received 2,451 likes. It features an illustration by Justin Erickson, as indicated by the text at the top of the post. The illustration depicts two characters within a heart-shaped frame with scalloped edges. On the left side of the heart, there is a werewolf character wearing a red shirt and black pants. The werewolf appears to be smiling and has a somewhat playful expression. On the right side of the heart, there is a woman with long, dark red hair
